questions.question: Explain contrasting Christian and Muslim views on the death penalty.

points.text: The Catholic Church and Church of England now oppose the death penalty in all cases, teaching that only God should end life and that forgiveness is central to Christianity. Jesus said "Let him who is without sin cast the first stone" (John 8:7). questions.question: "Forgiveness means criminals should not be punished." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Forgiveness does not mean no consequences — it means not holding resentment and wishing the offender well. Both Christianity and Islam teach forgiveness alongside justice. A murderer can be forgiven by the victim's family but still face punishment to protect society and uphold justice.
